script_text: Stop, Gemini — the cosmos just flipped a card you didn't see coming. Mercury, your ruling planet, is moving through Virgo in your 4th House of Home, forming a tense square to Neptune. As an Air sign, you process truth through communication — but these secrets resist logic. Conversations you thought were buried are resurfacing with force, and not everything people say today has clean intentions. Family matters are clouded by illusions. In love, Venus in Leo activates your 3rd House of Communication, but that Neptune square means someone's words don't match their actions. Singles, you're attracting intensity — trust your gut. Taken Geminis, a hidden truth needs airing before midnight. Career-wise, Jupiter is expanding your 11th House of Networks — a collaboration could shift everything. Money flows through connections, not solo effort. Avoid signing anything confidential before 3 PM — that's when the square peaks. Follow for tomorrow's reading — the stars get even more intense.
